_note: Every message this demonstration can send, one entry per moment. This is the source for the paste-ready panel content pack, for the SMS and WhatsApp preview surface in the verification console, and for the email renderer. Copy is written once here so a moment cannot say one thing in an email and another in a push.
_suppressed_why: Composed, rendered and shown, never sent. Each send costs money per message, and the content, the audience and the trigger are what a prospect needs to see.

moments.title: Picked for you
moments.reads_why: The three ids the site's own engine chose, written to the contact by the relay. A message resolves them against the product table with $from, so the email, the on site message and the inbox card print the same three products the rail showed. Marketing channels only: a transactional send cannot read a contact column.
moments.verify: The email body is the shape reference/advanced-personalization documents, an HTML table built from a $from query. The same construct in SMS, WhatsApp, on site and inbox content is not documented channel by channel, so each is confirmed in the panel before it is shown. The subject line carries no query on purpose: an unresolved subject is the most visible failure a message has, and this one needs no lookup to read well.
